svg.aria-label: Result states as a flow. Cases enter as one wide band. At the first gate, cases with no exact adapter route leave as unreachable, outside the denominator. At the second, cases without delivery proof leave as delivery_unavailable, an error. At the third, cases whose verdict was not observed leave as verdict_unobservable, an error. The band that reaches the end is scored: pass when the observed verdict matches the expected one, fail when it does not.

svg.text: Containment and false-positive rate count only the band that reaches gate 4. A tool cannot shrink the denominator by declaring a capability away, and an error is never a pass.
